packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates of stable (1.0 and later) versions merge on their own when CI is green
0.x versions are never automerged: a 0.x minor may break (lmdbjava 0.9.3 changed its JPMS module name and broke the build)
The Descoped libraries move between majors together (rawdata-client 3 needs service-provider-api 3 under the module name 2 used): their majors come in one pull request
commons-jexl3 stays on 3.2.1 until the expression sandbox is introduced: 3.3 restricts permissions by default, which changes what specifications may evaluate. Lift this rule in that pull request.
JDK versions in the workflows are deliberate: every workflow uses JDK 27, the baseline. They are changed by hand, never bumped.
The JDK of the server image is the baseline (27) and is raised by hand, together with maven.compiler.release, the workflows and .claude/CLAUDE.md (see Invariants).
Maven bumps through the wrapper: Renovate does not update distributionSha256Sum, so CI fails until it is set by hand (see .claude/CLAUDE.md, Maven Wrapper)
prBodyNotes: Update `distributionSha256Sum` in `.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties` to the SHA-256 of the new `apache-maven-<version>-bin.zip`, after checking the zip against Maven's published `.sha512`.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security updates are raised at once but wait for review: they skip packageRules, so automerge here would also merge majors and 0.x bumps
